verdict.rationale: Pipedream's docs list app triggers ('Triggers for apps like Twitter, GitHub, and more') alongside Email and HTTP/Webhook triggers, and describe source-available triggers for thousands of integrated apps. A community user describes an Airtable base auto-feeding an Algolia index, which corroborates app-event-driven workflows. Missing for 10: specific documentation of the named event types (new record, new message, form submission) beyond the generic app-trigger and email-trigger listings, and stronger independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can trigger workflows from events in connected apps (new record, message, email, form submission)

citations.quote: Source-available triggers and actions for thousands of integrated apps
Today, we support the following triggers: Triggers for apps like Twitter, GitHub, and more, HTTP / Webhook, Schedule, Email, RSS
create a search widget powered by a client-editable Airtable base that auto-feeds into an Algolia index
